summary: 105 new site(s) today, 1895 still listed, 58 off the market.
notes: Market (REINZ Sep 2026): Auckland median $950k, 47 days to sell, prices about 3% lower than a year ago. Cotality: Auckland -3.2% for the year. ANZ expects prices to drift lower to mid-2027, then recover. It is a buyer's market: motivated sellers are where the deepest discounts to CV are.

Future growth % is an indicative 5-year scenario, not a forecast: an Auckland base of about +9% (flat to mid-2027, then the long-run ~2.6%/yr), plus about +3.5 points within 800 m of a train station (CBRE: rail catchments outgrew Auckland by ~7 points over 10 years) and +1.5 for the Eastern Busway. The range is ±8 points.

School ratings: secondary schools are rated on actual results (school leavers with NCEA Level 3+, 2023–25) against the Auckland average of about 68%. High = 10+ points above, Low = 15+ below (Lynfield College 57.7% and One Tree Hill College 56% are at the low end of Medium). Primary and intermediate schools publish no results, so their rating uses the Equity Index (EQI, the replacement for deciles): a lower EQI means fewer socioeconomic barriers. Open the ERO link for the quality review.
State housing = Kāinga Ora parcels in LINZ's Central Record of State Land (the same data as your LINZ map), counted within 100 / 200 / 400 m of the site.

Expected price = asking price if stated, otherwise the average of the site estimate and CV × the suburb's typical sale/CV ratio. Low case = CV × that suburb's bottom-quarter ratio for 600 m²+ sites (12 months, 2,200 Auckland sales); it varies a lot by suburb, e.g. Avondale 69%, Mt Roskill 86%, Mt Albert 91%, Lynfield 94% of CV.
Slope comes from Auckland Council's 2024 LiDAR (1 m bare-earth) measured inside the title boundary: Flat <5% average, Gentle 5–10%, Moderate 10–20%, Steep 20%+. Steeper sites cost more to develop.

Sale type: mortgagee sales, estate sales and private sales usually go below market and are tagged. Mortgagee sales in Auckland right now are mostly outside your suburbs or budget; 43 Tawera Rd, Greenlane (809 m², consented for 5 homes) is a mortgagee auction on 4 Nov but its CV is $3.18m. Possible private sale lead: a 774 m² New Windsor do-up on Trade Me asking $920,000 (address withheld).

Sold tracking: every week the shortlisted listings are checked for sales and their sale price is compared with the CV and our expected price; the sale/CV ratios are refreshed weekly from a rolling 12 months of sales.
